text:
Welcome to the Vietnam National Fine Arts Museum, or Bảo tàng Mỹ thuật Việt Nam. This museum offers a fascinating glimpse into Vietnamese visual arts, showcasing a diverse collection of sculpture, lacquer painting, and traditional art forms. 

The museum is open from 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM, and the entrance fee is 40,000 VND. Please note that guided tours are available for an additional cost, so if you wish to enrich your experience, consider this option.

When planning your visit, keep in mind that access may vary on Mondays, especially around holidays, so it’s advisable to confirm in advance. This museum offers a distinctive experience compared to private art museums, highlighting the rich cultural heritage of Vietnam.

Enjoy your time exploring the remarkable art and history housed within these walls!
